display.purpose: The empty-state title, and nothing else.

title.purpose: Settings panel heading and the product wordmark.

body.purpose: Assistant answers and user messages — text that is read.

control.purpose: Every button, row, tab, menu item, and field — text that is scanned.

caption.purpose: Group labels, settings descriptions, the session stats line.

code.purpose: Code blocks, terminal output, and diff lines.

doc-title.purpose: A title painted inside a document preview; sized to the document, not the UI.

doc-subtitle.purpose: A subhead inside a document preview.

doc-body.purpose: Body text inside a document preview, at the document's own reading size.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: A button sitting on a surface; a segmented control's lifted segment.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The composer card, a tooltip, a back-to-bottom control.

shadows.name: resting-dark
shadows.purpose: The same step over the dark canvas, with a light hairline and a deeper cast.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every enter and expand. Covers most of its distance immediately and settles.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The two cases needing symmetry: a column sliding shut, a chip collapsing.

breakpoints.name: sidebar-rail
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the sidebar collapses to a 52px icon rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one accent fill in the system; one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(0, 113, 227); color: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(0, 119, 237); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgb(0, 104, 209); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(0, 113, 227); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default AppKit button: a white face, a hairline edge, and a resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(245, 245, 247); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A chrome-free control that fills only under the pointer.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The object the user addresses directly, and the softest shape in the product.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: 100%; max-width: 752px; padding: 10px 0 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); } .ds-composer-field { padding: 2px 12px 0 16px; color: rgb(174, 174, 178); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; } .ds-composer-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-composer-chip, .ds-composer-model { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 26px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 6px; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-composer-model { color: rgb(29, 29, 31); margin-left: auto; } .ds-composer-model b { color: rgb(110, 110, 115); font-weight: 500; } .ds-composer-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(0, 113, 227); color: #fff; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-composer-send:hover { background: rgb(0, 119, 237); }

components.css: .ds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 260px; padding: 8px; background: rgb(245, 245, 247); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 6px; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-row-selected { background: rgb(0, 113, 227); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.35; } .ds-row-selected .ds-row-dot { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-row-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-time { font-size: 11px; color: rgb(110, 110, 115); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row-selected .ds-row-time { color: #fff; opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Settings Group
components.description: The macOS inset group: rows in a white card on a grey panel, with separators inset from the card edge.
components.html:
Agent presetApplies to sessions you start from now on.
PermissionChoose the default permission mode.
components.css: .ds-group { width: 480px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; } .ds-group-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; } .ds-group-row + .ds-group-row::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-group-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; } .ds-group-title { color: rgb(29, 29, 31); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-group-desc { color: rgb(88, 88, 93); font-size: 11px; line-height: 15px; } .ds-popup { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-popup:hover { background: rgb(245, 245, 247); } .ds-popup-chevron { opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A white face with a hairline edge; focus is an accent ring plus a glow.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.14); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(174, 174, 178); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgb(0, 113, 227); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 113, 227, 0.1); }

components.name: Stacked Tabs
components.description: The selected tab is the darkest ink plus a 1.5px rule — position, not a second colour.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 0 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 0 0 9px; color: rgb(110, 110, 115); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.12s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: rgb(29, 29, 31); } .ds-tab-active { color: rgb(29, 29, 31); } .ds-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 1.5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(29, 29, 31); }

components.description: A report, not a performance: a 22px line with a leading glyph and a truncating summary.
components.css: .ds-tool { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; color: rgb(29, 29, 31); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 22px; } .ds-tool-icon { flex: none; width: 16px; color: rgb(110, 110, 115); } .ds-tool-title { flex: none; font-weight: 400; } .ds-tool-sep { flex: none; width: 3px; height: 3px; margin: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(174, 174, 178); } .ds-tool-summary { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: rgb(110, 110, 115); }

narrative.overview:
Baby Whale looks like a native macOS window that happens to run in a browser. The user is not visiting a product; they are working in a tool they opened this morning and will still have open this afternoon. Everything follows from that: the interface has one canvas, a small number of materials, and a strict rule about where the accent colour is allowed to appear.

The system is built on a closed neutral ramp rather than on a palette of greys. Every surface role — canvas, chrome, card, elevated control — is assigned a named step of that ramp, and a component that needs a tone picks a role instead of mixing a new value. There is exactly one accent, and it means "you can press this" or "this is where you are". It never marks decoration, and it never marks two things in the same column at the same time.

Density is set for the sixth hour of use rather than the first screenshot. Controls are 13px, prose is 15px, and rows are 28px tall, because a source list that fits eight sessions without scrolling is worth more than a list that looks airy in a marketing still. Depth comes from a three-step elevation ladder where each step is a hairline plus a contact and an ambient shadow, never from a single blurred smudge.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, spent only on things that can be pressed and on the current selection.
A closed neutral ramp; components consume roles, never raw greys.
macOS control geometry: 13px labels, 26–30px controls, 4/6/8/12/16px corners assigned by the size of the thing rounded.
Depth as a hairline plus a two-part shadow; translucency only where something real is behind the surface.
The deliverable outranks the process: tool rows report, they do not perform.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent appears at most once per column at rest. A sidebar shows one selected row; a settings panel shows one selected nav cell and one primary button, never both at once. Two accent objects in one column means the hierarchy has failed, and the fix is to remove one, not to add a third.

rules.name: The Selection Inverts Rule
rules.body: A selected item takes the accent as its fill with inverted ink, never as a coloured edge or a tinted label. Every descendant that draws in currentColor — a state dot, a chevron, an icon — inverts with it, so a selected row reads as one object instead of a blue box with coloured confetti on it.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: No text uses a step below tertiary, and in the light palette tertiary and caption are the same value. This is a floor, not a preference: on the sidebar's own fill, a neutral must sit at or under ~112 to clear 4.5:1, so the light ramp has room for exactly two steps below primary. quaternary exists for decoration and must never be the only thing carrying a meaning.

rules.name: The Step-Apart Rule
rules.body: Adjacent steps in the scale differ by at least 2px of size or one weight step. A 13px label and a 13px description in the same row are separated by ink, not by size, and a description never appears below its own title without one of the two.

dos: Do assign a surface a role from the closed ramp (--dsw-gray-* via an alias) rather than writing a new grey.
Do keep the accent to one object per column at rest, and prefer removing one over adding a third.
Do give a selected item the accent fill with inverted ink, and set color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary-foreground) on it so its descendants invert with it.
Do pair a font size with a line height from the scale, and keep a settings row's separator inset from the card edge.
Do check any new text colour against 4.5:1 on its real backdrop — the translucent fills composite, so a token that passes on white may fail on the sidebar.
Do keep backdrop-filter off any element that contains a portaled menu.
donts: Don't use --dsw-alias-label-quaternary, --dsw-alias-label-dimmed, or --dsw-alias-separator-primary for text that carries meaning; they are decoration and fall below the contrast floor.
Don't put a theme selector ([data-ds-dark-theme]) in a feature stylesheet; light/dark overrides belong to ui-theme.

Don't write a literal colour in a feature stylesheet, or reach for the raw --dsw-static-* palette; each one that remains is a surface that has not migrated yet. The single documented exception is the framework-free boot page, which paints before any theme CSS can load and therefore mirrors the palette values as literals.
Don't animate width, height, padding, or margin; animate transform, opacity, background, or grid tracks.
Don't use an overshoot or elastic easing curve. A macOS control answers a press by darkening, not by moving.
Don't reach for a capsule (border-radius: 999px) on a rectangular control; the capsule is the iOS button and reads as a marketing CTA, not as a window control.
